brief:
Zeteo compiled a weekly roundup of underreported incidents from occupied Gaza and the West Bank as Israel continues military operations and enforcement of control policies in both territories. The summary highlighted video documentation capturing what Zeteo characterized as instances of violence in both locations.

The report did not detail the specific content or nature of the documented incidents beyond their geographic locations and video format.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Videos document Israeli violence in Gaza and West Bank
